why: Both land on the same bank/financial-automation hedgehog with a per-customer denominator, list all three key brutal facts, and each puts two of the key's three stop-doing items in its list (Analysis 1: Rival I and service-starving cost cuts; Analysis 2: Rival I and deciding by force of personality). Analysis 1 edges ahead because it flags the actual decline mechanism, cost cuts eroding service, alongside dependence on one forceful executive, and its verdict is tighter, while Analysis 2 treats cost-cutting only weakly and passes its decline gate despite the warning signs it logs.
